Issue 1, 2016

NOW AVAILABLE

Wolfram Programming Lab »
Start using today's most advanced programming language
and get introduced to modem computational thinking with
Programming Lab's built-in, step-by-step Explorations.
Create amazing programs in minutes—even if you've never
coded before. Try it now.

FEATURED HIGHLIGHT

Wolfram Language Code Gallery »
The Wolfram Language Code Gallery is now instantly
accessible in the free Open Cloud. Explore the gallery to see
what's possible with Wolfram Development Platform and the
Wolfram Language.

FROM THE EXPERTS

New Dates Added for Hands-on Start to
Wolfram Mathematica Training Tutorials »
Join a free training session and learn how to interact with
Mathematica directly from the authors of Hands-on Start to
Wolfram Mathematica and Programming with the Wolfram
Language. Sign up now.

EFTA00631633

 Modeling and Simulation with Wolfram
SystemModeler: Virtual Workshop »
Discover new features in Wolfram SystemModeler 4.2 and
explore real-world modeling examples with our experts on
February 9. Seats are limited, so register today.

JUST POSTED

New Wolfram Language Books »
Check out the latest publications incorporating Wolfram
technologies. Popular new titles also include An Elementary
Introduction to the Wolfram Language by Stephen Wolfram
and Hands-on Start to Wolfram Mathematica and
Programming with the Wolfram Language.

IN THE SPOTLIGHT

Summer School Programs »
Applications are now being accepted for the 2016 Wolfram
Summer Programs. Mathematica and Tech Innovation tracks
are offered. Find the program that's right for you.
